description: Store one photo dropped on the Shoot Board, sent inline as base64, for a host that cannot upload files itself. Returns a receipt (sha256, size, stored, image_url, image_url_expires_at); pass image_url to mcp_intake_files and mcp_commit_intake. Without data, stores nothing and returns the receipt of the photo already stored under sha256 (a fresh image_url), or stored: false.

content_type.description: Image MIME type of data (required with data)

data.description: The image bytes, standard base64, at most 4 MiB decoded (downscale larger photos). Omit it to ask for the receipt of a photo already stored

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the dropped file as the user picked it (the intake tools take the same value), even when data is a downscaled copy

name: mcp_upload_intake_photo
title: Upload Dropped Photo
